paper.title: Uncertainty Calibration for Counterfactual Propensity Estimation in Recommendation

source.missing_from_repository: train_rec_with_MRDR.py, called by scripts/train_rec_with_MRDR.sh; no DR or MRDR training code is public

source.role: MRDR losses and training loop (reference [1] of the paper), ported from TensorFlow 1 to PyTorch

parity: DCG@{2,4,6} and Recall@{2,4,6}: author utils/metrics.py vs port on 50 random draws, both branches, max |difference| 2.2e-16 (docs/archive/2026-11-04/mrdr_cal_clev/mrdr_metrics_parity.log)
from_source: NeuMF: GMF and MLP embeddings of 64, MLP [64, 32, 16] with dropout before each layer, xavier MLP weights, N(0, 0.01) embeddings
Propensity: logit NeuMF on observed pairs plus as many sampled unobserved pairs, 90% random split, BCE with logits, Adam 1e-3, Coat 100 epochs, others 20, no label smoothing
Platt: a = 0.6, b = 0 at start, LBFGS lr 0.01, max_iter 1000, fitted on a fresh observed + unobserved sample; logits computed without model.eval()

MRDR (Guo): copy prediction -> imputation each epoch; imputation loss mean(CE / p * (1 - p) / p) on observed pairs; DR loss (e - e_il) * o / p + e_il on observed pairs mixed with 6x unobserved pairs (len(observed) rows drawn without replacement); keep the epoch with the lowest validation cross-entropy
Backbone hyperparameters from the paper appendix: embedding 64, batch 1024, lr 1e-3, dropout 0.2, L2 1e-4; imputation L2 1e-3 from Guo
Data: Coat/Yahoo MNAR train, MAR test, conversion = rating > 3; KuaiRand-Pure standard logs train, random log 10% validation / 90% test, target is_click
Metrics: global AUC, per-user AUC, unnormalised DCG@{2,4,6}, Recall@{2,4,6} hit counts (Coat, Yahoo), per-user normalised recall for KuaiRand
local_choices: CPU, PyTorch; Adam weight decay instead of the explicit L2 terms of the TF1 code
Coat/Yahoo: 10% of the MNAR ratings are held out for MRDR selection (paper text); the propensity model still uses the whole MNAR set as in the author code
Epoch caps for MRDR: Coat 200, Yahoo 50, KuaiRand 20 (Guo stops after 100 epochs without improvement; CPU budget)
Seeded numpy Generator for negative sampling instead of the unseeded global np.random
KuaiRand: users and videos mapped jointly over the three Pure logs; duplicate rows kept (author code reads rows as they are)
known_paper_code_differences: KuaiRand: the author recall_at_k divides by the user's positives (<= 1) while Tables V-VI report Recall@4 and Recall@6 above 1; both forms are reported here
Paper reports 1,186,509 random KuaiRand rows; the Pure random log has 1,186,059
